name: Creature Feature
storyline: A bootleg arcade cartridge labeled "CREATURE FEATURE" surfaces with something fundamentally wrong about it. The sprites move when they shouldn't. And the game remembers what you did last run. Each playthrough peels back another layer of corruption as the cursed arcade fights to keep you playing forever.
summary:
Creature Feature is a bullet heaven set inside a cursed 80s arcade cartridge. Fight through waves of glitched creatures, evolve weapons into devastating final forms, hunt ARPG loot with random affixes, and try not to notice when the game starts corrupting itself around you.

Featuring 7 playable characters, endless weapon combinations and evolutions, a full ARPG loot system with 60 unique items, a persistent skill tree, 4 maps, 6 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and full controller support.
